create_jwt_key_mapping: create a JWT key mapping that links a JWT claim name and value to a virtual API key
update_jwt_key_mapping: update an existing JWT key mapping by ID with new claim values or description
delete_jwt_key_mapping: delete a JWT key mapping by its ID from the database
list_jwt_key_mappings: list all JWT key mappings with pagination support ordered by creation date
get_jwt_key_mapping_info: retrieve detailed information for a single JWT key mapping by its ID
